description: This file provides a utility function 'withTempDir' for creating and managing temporary directories, including setup and cleanup, using Node.js promises and filesystem APIs.

methods.name: export async function withTempDir<T>( withTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with optional subdirectory, executes a provided async function with the directory path, and then cleans up by removing the directory.

ctags.name: base
ctags.pattern: /^  const base = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(options.parentDir ?? os.tmpdir(), options.prefix));$/

ctags.name: dir
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/
